arxiv-2108-13938.title: Quantifying the Underlying Event: Investigating Angular Dependence of Multiplicity Classes and Transverse-momentum Spectra in High-energy pp Collisions at LHC Energies
arxiv-2108-13938.creator: Aditya Nath Mishra 1 , Gergely Gábor Barnaföldi 1 and Guy Paić 2
arxiv-2108-13938.description: Abstract We present a study of the transverse momentum spectra and their evolution in function of the position of the azimuthal of the particles associated to the leading particle. Additionally, the behavior of the spherocity distribution in the same azimuthal bins is reported.

arxiv-2209-00114.title: RAPTOR: Ravenous Throughput Computing
arxiv-2209-00114.creator: Andre Merzky, Matteo Turilli, Shantenu Jha
arxiv-2209-00114.description: Abstract We describe the design, implementation and performance of the RADICAL-Pilot task overlay (RAPTOR). RAPTOR enables the execution of heterogeneous tasks—i.e., functions and executables with arbitrary duration—on HPC platforms, providing high throughput and high resource utilization. RAPTOR supports the high throughput virtual screening requirements of DOE’s National Virtual Biotechnology Laboratory effort to find therapeutic solutions for COVID-19.

arxiv-2308-04428.title: Sample-Efficient Linear Representation Learning from Non-IID Non-Isotropic Data
arxiv-2308-04428.creator: Thomas T. Zhang, Leonardo F. Toso, James Anderson, Nikolai Matni
arxiv-2308-04428.description: Abstract A powerful concept behind much of the recent progress in machine learning is the extraction of common features across data from heterogeneous sources or tasks. Intuitively, using all of one’s data to learn a common representation function benefits both computational effort and statistical generalization by leaving a smaller number of parameters to fine-tune on a given task.

arxiv-2407-21212.title: Non-normable spaces of analytic functions
arxiv-2407-21212.creator: Iván Jiménez, Dragan Vukotić
arxiv-2407-21212.description: Abstract . For each value of p p such that 0 < p < 1 0<p<1 , we give a specific example of two functions in the Hardy space H p H^{p} and in the Bergman space A p A^{p} that do not satisfy the triangle inequality.

arxiv-2510-05251.title: Let it Calm: Exploratory Annealed Decoding for Verifiable Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2510-05251.creator: Chenghao Yang, Lin Gui, Chenxiao Yang, Victor Veitch, Lizhu Zhang, Zhuokai Zhao
arxiv-2510-05251.description: Abstract Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is a powerful paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), yet its success hinges on effective exploration. An ideal exploration strategy must navigate two fundamental challenges: it must preserve sample quality while also ensuring training stability.

pmc-11437055.title: The effect of anionic emulsifiers’ diversity and manufacturing processes on the stability and mechanical properties of the water-based epoxy-emulsified asphalt
pmc-11437055.creator: Yi Peng, Jinke Miao, Xinyi Yu, Yifan Yang, Qingguo Yang, Lingyun Kong, Weina Wang, Yong Chen, Feng Liang, Tao Ao
pmc-11437055.description: Emulsified asphalt mixtures’ cold mix and paving features facilitate asphalt pavements in fulfilling dual-carbon and energy-saving demands. Anionic emulsifiers can enhance emulsion stability, ensure uniform dispersion of oil and water, possess good decompression viscosity, thickening, and lubricating properties, and maintain good stability under acidic conditions.

pmc-11478195.title: Are Palliative Interventions Worth the Risk in Advanced Gastric Cancer? A Systematic Review
pmc-11478195.creator: Alicia A Gingrich, Renceh B Flojo, Allyson Walsh, Jennifer Olson, Danielle Hanson, Sarah B Bateni, Sepideh Gholami, Amanda R Kirane, Maximos Frountzas
pmc-11478195.description: Background: Less than 25% of gastric cancers (GC) are discovered early, leading to limited treatment options and poor outcomes (27.8% mortality, 3.7% 5-year survival). Screening programs have improved cure rates, yet post-diagnosis treatment guidelines remain unclear (systemic chemotherapy versus surgery).

pmc-11621627.title: Expert consensus on the off-label use in China of drugs for rare hematologic diseases (2024 edition)
pmc-11621627.creator: Boxin Zhao, Xuan Zhou, Ping Zheng, Bo Zhang, Xiaoqin Feng, Jie Chen, Lisheng Cai, Yilu Chen, Liya He, Jianfen Su, Shuqin Cheng, Yingtong Zeng, Guowei Li, Bo Ji, Jianlong Wu, Weiyi Feng, Maobai Liu, Yiran Jin, Taotao Liu, Xiaolan Mo, Junyan Wu, Hui Wu, Hongliang Zhang, Zhichang Zheng, Zhihua Zheng, J
pmc-11621627.description: Drug package inserts are a crucial foundation for clinical medication practices and serve as the legal basis for guiding rational drug use and ensuring patient safety and efficacy. As rare disease treatments evolve, current package inserts often need to meet the clinical requirements for treating such conditions, frequently resulting in off-label drug use.

pmc-12479829.title: Severity of COVID-19 Associated with SARS-CoV-2 Variants Dominant Period in the Republic of Korea
pmc-12479829.creator: Se-Jin Jeong, Misuk An, Minjeong Jang, So Young Choi, You-Jung Choi, Jinhwa Jang, Boyeong Ryu, Shin Young Park, Seong-Sun Kim, 세진 정, 미숙 안, 민정 장, 소영 최, 유정 최, 진화 장, 보영 류, 신영 박, 성순 김
pmc-12479829.description: This report seeks to compare and analyze the severity trends of coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) in Republic of Korea during periods of dominant variant virus prevalence. The analysis covers the period from January 20, 2020, to July 31, 2023, categorizing the severity of COVID-19 cases both throughout the entire period and during periods of dominant variant virus prevalence.

pmc-12585182.title: Noninvasive Follicular Thyroid Neoplasm With Papillary-Like Nuclear Features Arising in the Thyroglossal Duct: A Case Report and Literature Review
pmc-12585182.creator: Manami Momii, Shingo Umemoto, Takenao Tei, Takashi Hirano
pmc-12585182.description: A noninvasive follicular thyroid neoplasm with papillary-like nuclear features (NIFTP) is a recently reclassified thyroid tumor characterized by low malignant potential and typically confined to the thyroid gland. Its occurrence in a thyroglossal duct remnant is exceedingly rare, with only a few cases reported.

pmc-12650831.title: Kicked General Fractional Lorenz-Type Equations: Exact Solutions and Multi-Dimensional Discrete Maps
pmc-12650831.creator: Vasily E. Tarasov
pmc-12650831.description: Lorenz-type systems are dissipative dynamical systems that are described by three nonlinear equations with derivatives of the first order and are capable of exhibiting chaotic behavior. The generalization of Lorenz-type equations by using general fractional derivatives (GFDs) and periodical kicks is proposed.

pmc-12994539.title: Delicate molecular design, self-assembly and functional applications of chiral cyclophanes
pmc-12994539.creator: Yiming Zhang, Hongzhe Jia, Lijin Xu, Minghua Liu, Guanghui Ouyang
pmc-12994539.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Chiral cyclophanes represent a unique supramolecular architecture that integrates chiral cavities with luminescent properties, enabled by their precisely controlled interchromophoric orientation, distance, and asymmetry. These features confer exceptional chiral recognition capabilities and distinctive chiroptical behaviors. Over the past decade, advances in synthetic strategies alongside improved computational and analytical tools, have greatly accelerated the development of diverse chiral cyclophane structures and deepened mechanistic understanding.

pmc-13087520.title: Delayed Breastfeeding Initiation and Associated Factors in Tanzania: A Cross‐Sectional Study
pmc-13087520.creator: Linus Paul Rweyemamu, Erneus Ernest, Christopher Hariri Mbotwa
pmc-13087520.description: Background and AimsDelayed initiation of breastfeeding is associated with poor child development outcomes and increased risk of infant mortality, which remains a major public health challenge in low‐ and middle‐income countries. Despite global and national efforts to promote optimal breastfeeding, early initiation remains suboptimal in much of Sub‐Saharan Africa.

pmc-13189464.title: Hypoxia‐Mediated Downregulation of Exosomal miR‐128‐3p Promotes Lymphangiogenesis via VEGF‐C in Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma
pmc-13189464.creator: Tengchao You, Furong Mao, Kesheng Zhang, Xulin Zhang, Xiaohua Hu
pmc-13189464.description: BackgroundCancer cell‐derived exosomal microRNAs (miRNAs) are crucial mediators of intercellular communication within the tumor microenvironment, including with lymphatic endothelial cells (LECs). Hypoxia, a key driver of tumor aggressiveness, modulates exosome release and cargo. However, the specific functions of exosomal miRNAs derived from hypoxic oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) cells are not well defined.MethodsWe employed a two‐phase strategy.

uslaw-usc-t16-s825s3.title: 16 U.S.C. § 825s–3 — Southwestern area sale at uniform systemwide rates of electric power over transmission lines constructed with appropriated funds or used under contractual arrangements
uslaw-usc-t16-s825s3.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s825s3.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 12 (Federal Regulation And Development Of Power); Subchapter III (Licensees And Public Utilities; Procedural And Administrative Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Power and energy marketed by the Southwestern Power Administration pursuant to section 825s of this title, shall be sold at uniform systemwide rates, without discrimination between customers to whom the Southwestern Power Administration.
